about.title: About Daily Tale
about.metaDescription: Learn about Daily Tale, our global multilingual folktale library, educational mission, and founder Dr. S. Edward Packiaraj.
about.summary: Daily Tale – Moral Stories & Interesting Folktales is a multilingual digital storytelling sanctuary dedicated to nourishing character, imagination, and empathy through timeless folktales, fables, and heritage wisdom from world cultures.

sections.heading: Multilingual Folklore Treasury
sections.content: We bring together over 2,448 curated stories across 8 languages: English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, and Chinese (Simplified). Our collections span Akbar–Birbal, Tenali Rama, Panchatantra, Aesop's Fables, Jataka Tales, Hans Christian Andersen, the Brothers Grimm, Arabian Nights, and cultural folklore from across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

sections.heading: Audio & Adaptive Reading Toolbar
sections.content: Our platform offers browser-native audio narration with text-to-speech, sentence-by-sentence reading assistance, and adjustable playback speed (0.8x to 1.5x), along with specialized typography controls including the OpenDyslexic typeface, custom font sizing, fluid line-height adjustment, and night/sepia reading themes.

sections.heading: Structured Pedagogical Depth
sections.content: To support parents, educators, and language learners, every story includes structured Bloom's Taxonomy reflection prompts (spanning Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create levels), curated in-text vocabulary glossaries with exact definitions, and interactive comprehension quizzes that cultivate critical thinking and family dialogue.

sections.heading: Classroom & Community-Ready Resources
sections.content: We provide ready-to-share educational tools, including exportable 'Moral of the Day' cards, reading milestone certificates, printable story summaries, and seamless one-click sharing via WhatsApp, Telegram, and email for home, community, and classroom reflection.

sections.heading: Lightweight PWA & 100% Privacy Commitment
sections.content: Built with lightweight Progressive Web App (PWA) technology and browser-native audio capabilities, Daily Tale is designed for accessibility, instant offline reading, and minimal server dependency. Our commitment is absolute: 100% free, 100% ad-free, zero tracking, and zero user registration.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.content: To make timeless moral wisdom, character values, and world folklore freely accessible, understandable, and inspiring every day, supporting families, educators, and language learners in growing together in empathy and global literacy.

sections.heading: About Me — Edward Packiaraj
sections.content: S. Edward Packiaraj (M.Com., M.Phil., B.Ed., BLIS., PGDBA., PGDCA.) is Consultant – Educational Media Technologies, Rosary e-Solutions, Trichy. With 22 years of experience in radio broadcasting (All India Radio, IGNOU FM), 17+ years in Educational Technology / e-Content Development, 250+ invited lectures delivered, creator of 2000+ educational video lessons and 65+ Interactive Multimedia Self-Learning Packages, Board of Studies member at Centre for Distance Education, Bharathidasan University, Trichy, and Educational Technology Cell member at Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University, Chennai. Built on the belief that everyone deserves access to learning without paywalls: 'Learn More! Teach More!'

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.metaDescription: Educational and literary disclaimer regarding retold folklore, cultural parables, and linguistic translations.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of the Platform
sections.content: All stories, quizzes, moral summaries, and learning activities provided on Daily Tale are intended strictly for educational, ethical, and literary enjoyment. They do not constitute professional, legal, medical, or psychological advice.

sections.heading: 2. Folklore Retelling & Cultural Parables
sections.content: Stories originating from ancient lore, fables, and folk traditions are presented purely as cultural heritage and literary parables. To maintain a peaceful, universal, and non-sectarian environment accessible to families and readers of all faiths and beliefs worldwide, narratives focus on universal human values such as honesty, courage, empathy, and wisdom.

sections.heading: 3. Translations
sections.content: Multilingual translations are prepared with the assistance of advanced language models and reviewed by human linguists. While we strive for absolute linguistic elegance, nuances may occasionally differ. Readers are encouraged to reach out to suggest phrase refinements.

sections.heading: 4. Reader Submissions
sections.content: Original tales submitted by community members and published after moderation reflect the creative imagination of their respective authors, not the official stance of Daily Tale.

sections.heading: 5. Family & Educator Guidance
sections.content: While our editorial board strictly enforces family-safe ratings and community standards, parents and educators remain the ultimate guides of suitability for individual young readers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Plain-language, cookie-free privacy policy adhering to COPPA, GDPR, and global data protection laws. We protect readers by collecting zero unnecessary data.
privacy.summary: Plain Language Summary: We believe reading should be completely private. We do not require accounts, we do not track reading behavior across the web, we use zero third-party advertising trackers, and we never sell data. Your favorites and reading progress stay exclusively inside your own device's browser memory.

sections.heading: 1. What We Collect and Why
sections.content:
Because we operate without user logins for readers, we collect virtually no personal information:
• On-Device Data (localStorage): Your reading history, bookmarked favorites, and audio preferences remain strictly in your browser's local memory. We never transmit or store this on our servers.
• Daily Story Email Subscribers (Adults Only): When an adult subscribes to our daily story email, we store their email address and language preference securely. This requires explicit confirmation.
• Community Story Submissions: When a writer submits a story, we collect the submitted text, pen name, and contact email solely for editorial communication and attribution.
• Privacy-Friendly Aggregated Metrics: We log anonymous counts of page reads to understand which stories readers love. We do NOT log IP addresses, fingerprint devices, or run invasive tracking scripts.

sections.heading: 2. Reader Protection (COPPA & Global Standards)
sections.content:
We comply strictly with international child protection and data privacy standards:
• No personal data is knowingly requested or collected from children.
• Newsletter signups and contact forms are intended strictly for adults and guardians.
• If we learn that personal data of a minor has been unintentionally submitted, we purge it immediately.

sections.heading: 3. No Advertising & No Data Selling
sections.content: We do not sell, rent, monetize, or disclose user information to data brokers, ad networks, or commercial third parties under any circumstances.

sections.heading: 4. Your Rights & Data Deletion
sections.content: You have the right to request access, correction, or permanent erasure of any contact details or subscriber records associated with your email. You may contact support@dailystory.pages.dev at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: Terms of service governing reading, fair classroom use, community story submissions, and intellectual property rights.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using Daily Tale, you agree to these Terms of Use and our community guidelines. If you are accessing this platform on behalf of a minor, you represent that you are their parent, guardian, or authorized educator.

sections.heading: 2. Permitted Educational & Personal Use
sections.content: You are warmly welcome to read, listen to, and share these stories at home and in school classrooms. Teachers and educators are explicitly permitted to project stories and print worksheets for non-commercial educational use.

sections.heading: 3. Restrictions: No Scraping or Bulk Copying
sections.content: You may not systematically scrape, harvest, reproduce in bulk, mirror, or ingest our stories, translations, audio, or quizzes into automated commercial databases or competing services without prior written permission.

sections.heading: 4. Community Submission License
sections.content: When you submit an original story, you retain full copyright ownership of your work. By submitting, you grant Daily Tale a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to format, translate, and publish the story on our platform with credit to your pen name.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Daily Tale is provided on an 'as-is' and 'as-available' basis without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for incidental or consequential damages resulting from platform use.

copyright.title: Copyright & Takedown Policy
copyright.metaDescription: Notice of public domain sources, educational fair use, and our rapid 24-hour copyright review procedure.

sections.heading: Public Domain and Proprietary Content
sections.content: Traditional folktales and fables on this platform are drawn from public-domain folklore. Original retellings, translations, pedagogical quizzes, discussion cards, custom artwork, logos, and UI code are the exclusive intellectual property of Daily Tale.

sections.heading: Notice and Takedown Procedure
sections.content:
If you are a copyright owner or authorized agent and believe that content published on our platform infringes upon your copyright, please submit a written notice to support@dailystory.pages.dev including:
1. Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed.
2. The exact URL of the material on our platform.
3. Your contact address, phone number, and email.
4. A statement of good faith belief that the use is unauthorized.
5. A statement made under penalty of perjury that you are authorized to act.

sections.heading: Resolution Timeline
sections.content: Upon receipt of a valid notice, our team will review the claim, temporarily restrict access if warranted, and respond within 24 to 48 hours.
